fields.reasoning: check-time-target says a miss fails the leaf and the gap is raised, not the target loosened, so the target stays 5 s and the miss is not called a pass. But the leaf cannot close the gap by itself: it touches only internal/store/read.go, the decode it parallelised was about 1.3 s of CPU (7% in the 2026-11-15 profile), and the measured 16.25 s user + 4.14 s sys is at least 5.1 s even spread perfectly over 4 cores, so no retry inside the leaf's touch list could reach 5 s. What remains is WhatIfFrom (~19%), checker.model/inFlightLinks and render, all outside this leaf's scope. Failing the whole change set would throw away verified work that roughly halves check's time and matches every correctness point (model-seed-views and check-whatif-once both verified PASS). Raising the gap as its own change set keeps the target binding on milestone 39 while letting this change set's correct work land.
